content:
morgan: deploy-bot just flagged promotion for service 'search-worker' to staging as blocked. root cause: artifact index TTL drift + shard upload 404. deploying in ~20m. any quick ideas to unblock?

deploy-bot: [system] Promotion halted: artifact index checksum != storage manifest for search-worker:2026-03-02-rc5. Errors:
```
2026-03-23T10:12:03Z ERROR upload failed: PutObject shard-0 -> 404 Not Found
meta: expected-checksum=8f3a7c1d2, observed-checksum=UNKNOWN, cache-ttl=300s
```

sam: looks like cache manifest TTL rotated earlier and some shards expired before index update. We can either pin to previous working artifact or reupload rc5. Pin would be fastest.

jen: agree with pin. Reuploading rc5 will kick off cache invalidation and takes >10m; we might miss the release window. Need to call out in notes if we pin.

morgan: does rc9 differ in any incompatible ways? rc9 = 2026-02-28-rc9 (previous).

sam: rc9 only had a metrics flag change behind feature flag. Should be safe for runtime. No schema changes.

ben (release-manager): i'm ok with pin to rc9 for this release window. execute pin + hold canary. I'll update release notes and open a follow-up ticket.

carla (oncall): i'll try a parallel mirror reupload just in case pinning fails or if the team wants to flip later. Running:
```
gsutil -m cp -r gs://artifacts-staging/tmp-upload/search-worker/rc5/* gs://artifacts-staging/mirrors/search-worker/rc5/
```

deploy-bot: action: `promote --pin search-worker:2026-02-28-rc9` executed by ben at 1714207200. Canary: held (1/3). Mirror reupload started.

morgan: thanks. ben please add this to release notes: 'pinned search-worker to 2026-02-28-rc9 due to artifact index TTL drift causing shard 404; rc5 mirror reupload in progress; will reconcile post-release.'

ben: added to release notes and changelog. Follow-up ticket created: https://tracker.company/RED-3145

carla: mirror reupload finished. Post-reupload checksum for rc5 now matches expected: 8f3a7c1d2. Because we've pinned, we will not flip canary until triage.

morgan: current state: pinned + canary held. Follow-up triage scheduled tomorrow. Closing thread for release window. :white_check_mark:
